name: dsh-table-studio
description: Table studio for DeepSeek Harness: a conversation table card (copy / CSV download / expand) plus a right-side Excel-style spreadsheet editor bound locally to fortune-sheet (toolbar, formula bar, sheet tabs) with a jspreadsheet fallback, downloads saved straight to the default Downloads folder — no CDN, everything shipped in the package.
author: MYiYang <1791500400@qq.com>
